settings.content: Profiles, widths, metals and finishes that wear well for fifty years

settings.heading: Where to Begin
settings.body:
A plain band looks like the simplest thing in jewellery and is quietly one of the hardest to get right. Without stones, everything rests on proportion: the cross-section, the width, the depth, the metal and the finish.

Get those right and the ring becomes almost invisible in daily wear, which is exactly what you want from something worn for fifty years. Get them wrong and it sits in a drawer.

This guide covers each decision in turn, and is honest about where to spend and where it makes no difference.
